001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005import org.clafer.common.Util;
006
007/**
008 * foldl1 op operands.
009 *
010 * @author jimmy
011 */
012public record AstArithm(Op op, AstSetExpr[] operands) implements AstSetExpr {
013
014    public AstArithm {
015        op = Check.notNull(op);
016        operands = Check.noNullsNotEmpty(operands);
017    }
018
019    @Override
020    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
021        return obj instanceof AstArithm other
022                && op == other.op && Arrays.equals(operands, other.operands);
023    }
024
025    @Override
026    public int hashCode() {
027        // op.hashCode() can change between runs which makes the output change
028        // every time.
029        return op.ordinal() ^ Arrays.hashCode(operands);
030    }
031
032    @Override
033    public String toString() {
034        return "(" + Util.intercalate(") " + op.getSyntax() + " (", operands) + ")";
035    }
036
037    public static enum Op {
038
039        Add("+"),
040        Sub("-"),
041        Mul("*"),
042        Div("/"),
043        /**
044         * Multiplication of decimals, rounded half away from zero to the
045         * decimal scale. Introduced by type analysis.
046         */
047        DecimalMul("*"),
048        /**
049         * Division of decimals, rounded half away from zero to the decimal
050         * scale. Introduced by type analysis.
051         */
052        DecimalDiv("/");
053        private final String syntax;
054
055        private Op(String syntax) {
056            this.syntax = syntax;
057        }
058
059        public String getSyntax() {
060            return syntax;
061        }
062    }
063}
